in_hebrew.name: Holmann
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Holmann הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old German 'holla' meaning 'holy' and 'mann' meaning 'man'. This name is a tribute to those who uphold strong spiritual beliefs and maintain a pure, God-centered life.

This name is a tribute to those who uphold strong spiritual beliefs and maintain a pure, God-centered life.
